title: SBI Circle Based Officer CBO Final Marks 2026 – Out
vacancyDetails: 2273 Circle Based Officer posts across SBI Circles; posting only in applied Circle
qualification: Graduation with relevant experience as per SBI CBO notification (local banking / experience criteria apply)
applicationFee: As per SBI careers fee rules
selectionProcess: Online Exam → Interview → Final Merit / Provisional Selection
documentsRequired: Educational certificates, experience certificates, category certificate, photo ID, interview call letter
howToApply:
1. Visit https://sbi.bank.in or SBI Careers
2. Open Recruitment Results / CBO Final Result PDF
3. Search your Roll Number in the provisionally selected list
4. Download and save the PDF for joining formalities
5. Wait for offer letter / further instructions from SBI
shortDescription: SBI has released the Final Result of Circle Based Officers (CBO) 2026 for 2273 posts after interviews held in July 2026. Check roll numbers on sbi.bank.in.
content:
State Bank of India (SBI) has declared the Final Result for recruitment of Circle Based Officers (CBO).

Interviews were conducted during July 2026. The PDF lists roll numbers of candidates provisionally selected as Circle Based Officers.

Highlights

  • Total vacancies (cycle): 2273
  • Selection: Online test + Interview
  • Posting: Applied Circle only
  • Official PDF on SBI careers / bank portal

Selected candidates should regularly check email and SBI Careers for joining and document verification instructions.
